methodological_rigor.justification: The study develops scVital (a conditional VAE with adversarial discriminator) and a new integration metric (LSS) with appropriate sanity-check negative controls, robustness sampling (20 rounds of 80% subsampling), epoch-dependent convergence checks, and class-imbalance tests against ARI. Benchmarks are performed against four established tools (BBKNN, Harmony, scVI, scDREAMER) across diverse tissues (muscle, lung, pancreas, liver, bladder) and three cancer types (PDAC, LUAD, UPS), with runtime reported. Statistical reporting of the experimental validation (SLC2A1 IHC, pimonidazole) uses Mann–Whitney U with adequate replicates (n≥3 per group). Limitations include default hyperparameters derived by 'coarse grid search' without formal tuning protocol, n is small for some in vivo validation experiments, and benchmark datasets are heterogeneous which could affect conclusions.

clinical_relevance_loe.justification: The work indirectly improves translational cancer research by offering a tool to identify conserved cell states between GEMMs/PDXs and human tumors, which can inform target identification—illustrated by discovery of a shared doxorubicin-induced hypoxic cell state with SLC2A1 up-regulation in UPS. However, the contribution is a computational methodology plus preclinical validation, not a clinical intervention or direct biomarker application; Oxford LoE maps to 5 (basic science/mechanistic).

reporting_quality.justification: The work combines algorithm development with animal experiments (KPT GEMM, NSG PDX recipients with doxorubicin treatment), so ARRIVE is the applicable standard. Most ARRIVE items are covered: strain (RRID-tagged), sex, age, housing/institution, IACUC protocol (17-11-008), euthanasia method, tumor induction dose and route, treatment schedule, endpoints. Algorithm description is detailed with equations and a PyPI-style tool name (RRID: SCR_026215). Data availability is partially supported (tool identifier provided, references to public datasets), but raw scRNA-seq accession numbers are not visible in provided text; no explicit code repository URL is visible (many [REDACTED]).

novelty_literature.justification: While VAE-based single-cell integration is well-developed (scVI, scDREAMER), scVital offers a specific novel contribution: a species-aware reconstruction loss that masks species-specific genes (avoiding the 'zero-imputation' problem) and a new cluster-agnostic integration metric (LSS) based on cosine similarity and AUC-F1. Benchmarks show it matches or exceeds scDREAMER accuracy at ~10× lower runtime, and the tool recovers a doxorubicin-induced hypoxia program in UPS that missed-intersection gene approaches would not reveal. This is a novel method plus extension of prior cross-species analyses rather than a paradigm-shifting discovery.

writing_presentation.justification: The manuscript is clearly written with well-structured Methods detailing architecture, loss functions, and LSS derivation (with equations), and Results progressing logically from normal tissues to cancers to UPS. Figures 1–5 are informative and figure captions explain the integration metrics and hypoxia validation. Minor issues: some sections include unusual formatting with ArXiv IDs inline, and several image/data URLs are [REDACTED] in the provided text.

key_strengths: Novel species-aware reconstruction loss that distinguishes species-specific genes from zero expression, with a cluster-agnostic LSS evaluation metric addressing known ARI/FM weaknesses
Comprehensive benchmarks on five normal tissues and three cancers (PDAC, LUAD, UPS) against four established tools, with runtime advantages over scDREAMER
Biological validation via GEMM and PDX UPS experiments identifying a conserved doxorubicin-induced hypoxic SLC2A1+ state confirmed by IHC and pimonidazole staining
Open-source tool identifier (RRID: SCR_026215) and careful ARRIVE-aligned reporting of animal work
key_concerns: Default hyperparameters (wR=2, cosine annealing cycle length) set by coarse grid search without formal tuning protocol; sensitivity not fully characterized
LSS metric depends on pre-labeled cell types (explicitly acknowledged); quality of LSS is therefore bounded by prior annotation quality
In vivo validation cohorts are modest (n=3–8 per group across treatments) and confined to one disease context for the novel hypoxia finding
Raw scRNA-seq data accessions and explicit source-code repository URLs not visible in the provided text; reproducibility hinges on these being available
Some benchmarks (e.g., PDAC) show scDREAMER achieving higher LSS (0.95 vs 0.83) at far higher runtime; the tradeoff is favorable but accuracy is not always first
chief_reviewer.rationale: Novel, well-benchmarked computational method with meaningful preclinical validation that fills a real gap in cross-species cancer single-cell analysis; appropriate at tier 2 venues (Cancer Research, Nat Comms, Bioinformatics-plus-oncology) with minor revisions for hyperparameter sensitivity and data/code availability.
